We propose a label-agnostic NSP approach, which predicts whether the next sentence continues the current topic without requiring explicit topic labels, and enhance it with a segmentation-aware loss combined with harder negative sampling to better capture discourse continuity. Unlike recent proposals that leverage NSP alongside auxiliary topic classification, our approach avoids task-specific supervision. We evaluate our model against established baselines on two datasets, CitiLink-Minutes, for which we establish the first segmentation benchmark, and WikiSection. On CitiLink-Minutes, SegNSP achieves a B-$F_1$ of 0.79, closely aligning with human-annotated topic transitions, while on WikiSection it attains a B-F$_1$ of 0.65, outperforming the strongest reproducible baseline, TopSeg, by 0.17 absolute points. These results demonstrate competitive and robust performance, highlighting the effectiveness of modeling sentence-to-sentence continuity for improving segmentation quality and supporting downstream NLP applications.

title: CPGPrompt: Translating Clinical Guidelines into LLM-Executable Decision Support
summary:
Clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) provide evidence-based recommendations for patient care; however, integrating them into Artificial Intelligence (AI) remains challenging. Previous approaches, such as rule-based systems, face significant limitations, including poor interpretability, inconsistent adherence to guidelines, and narrow domain applicability. To address this, we develop and validate CPGPrompt, an auto-prompting system that converts narrative clinical guidelines into large language models (LLMs).
  Our framework translates CPGs into structured decision trees and utilizes an LLM to dynamically navigate them for patient case evaluation. Synthetic vignettes were generated across three domains (headache, lower back pain, and prostate cancer) and distributed into four categories to test different decision scenarios. System performance was assessed on both binary specialty-referral decisions and fine-grained pathway-classification tasks.
  The binary specialty referral classification achieved consistently strong performance across all domains (F1: 0.85-1.00), with high recall (1.00 $\pm$ 0.00). In contrast, multi-class pathway assignment showed reduced performance, with domain-specific variations: headache (F1: 0.47), lower back pain (F1: 0.72), and prostate cancer (F1: 0.77). Domain-specific performance differences reflected the structure of each guideline. The headache guideline highlighted challenges with negation handling. The lower back pain guideline required temporal reasoning. In contrast, prostate cancer pathways benefited from quantifiable laboratory tests, resulting in more reliable decision-making.

title: Online Decision-Making Under Uncertainty for Vehicle-to-Building Systems
comments: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Published in the Proceedings of the 16th ACM/IEEE International Conference on Cyber-Physical Systems (ICCPS '25), May 06--09, 2025, Irvine, CA, USA
summary: Vehicle-to-building (V2B) systems integrate physical infrastructures, such as smart buildings and electric vehicles (EVs) connected to chargers at the building, with digital control mechanisms to manage energy use. By utilizing EVs as flexible energy reservoirs, buildings can dynamically charge and discharge them to optimize energy use and cut costs under time-variable pricing and demand charge policies. This setup leads to the V2B optimization problem, where buildings coordinate EV charging and discharging to minimize total electricity costs while meeting users' charging requirements. However, the V2B optimization problem is challenging because of: (1) fluctuating electricity pricing, which includes both energy charges ($/kWh) and demand charges ($/kW); (2) long planning horizons (typically over 30 days); (3) heterogeneous chargers with varying charging rates, controllability, and directionality (i.e., unidirectional or bidirectional); and (4) user-specific battery levels at departure to ensure user requirements are met. In contrast to existing approaches that often model this setting as a single-shot combinatorial optimization problem, we highlight critical limitations in prior work and instead model the V2B optimization problem as a Markov decision process (MDP), i.e., a stochastic control process. Solving the resulting MDP is challenging due to the large state and action spaces. To address the challenges of the large state space, we leverage online search, and we counter the action space by using domain-specific heuristics to prune unpromising actions. We validate our approach in collaboration with Nissan Advanced Technology Center - Silicon Valley. Using data from their EV testbed, we show that the proposed framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Published in the Proceedings of the 16th ACM/IEEE International Conference on Cyber-Physical Systems (ICCPS '25), May 06--09, 2025, Irvine, CA, USA

title: Hybrid Approach for Driver Behavior Analysis with Machine Learning, Feature Optimization, and Explainable AI
summary: Progressive driver behavior analytics is crucial for improving road safety and mitigating the issues caused by aggressive or inattentive driving. Previous studies have employed machine learning and deep learning techniques, which often result in low feature optimization, thereby compromising both high performance and interpretability. To fill these voids, this paper proposes a hybrid approach to driver behavior analysis that uses a 12,857-row and 18-column data set taken from Kaggle. After applying preprocessing techniques such as label encoding, random oversampling, and standard scaling, 13 machine learning algorithms were tested. The Random Forest Classifier achieved an accuracy of 95%. After deploying the LIME technique in XAI, the top 10 features with the most significant positive and negative influence on accuracy were identified, and the same algorithms were retrained. The accuracy of the Random Forest Classifier decreased slightly to 94.2%, confirming that the efficiency of the model can be improved without sacrificing performance. This hybrid model can provide a return on investment in terms of the predictive power and explainability of the driver behavior process.

title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
summary: Recent years have witnessed success of sequential modeling, generative recommender, and large language model for recommendation. Though the scaling law has been validated for sequential models, it showed inefficiency in computational capacity when considering real-world applications like recommendation, due to the non-linear(quadratic) increasing nature of the transformer model. To improve the efficiency of the sequential model, we introduced a novel approach to sequential recommendation that leverages personalization techniques to enhance efficiency and performance. Our method compresses long user interaction histories into learnable tokens, which are then combined with recent interactions to generate recommendations. This approach significantly reduces computational costs while maintaining high recommendation accuracy. Our method could be applied to existing transformer based recommendation models, e.g., HSTU and HLLM. Extensive experiments on multiple sequential models demonstrate its versatility and effectiveness. Source code is available at \href{https://github.com/facebookresearch/PerSRec}{https://github.com/facebookresearch/PerSRec}.

title: Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales
summary: Hate speech detection models rely on surface-level lexical features, increasing vulnerability to spurious correlations and limiting robustness, cultural contextualization, and interpretability. We propose Supervised Moral Rationale Attention (SMRA), the first self-explaining hate speech detection framework to incorporate moral rationales as direct supervision for attention alignment. Based on Moral Foundations Theory, SMRA aligns token-level attention with expert-annotated moral rationales, guiding models to attend to morally salient spans rather than spurious lexical patterns. Unlike prior rationale-supervised or post-hoc approaches, SMRA integrates moral rationale supervision directly into the training objective, producing inherently interpretable and contextualized explanations. To support our framework, we also introduce HateBRMoralXplain, a Brazilian Portuguese benchmark dataset annotated with hate labels, moral categories, token-level moral rationales, and socio-political metadata. Across binary hate speech detection and multi-label moral sentiment classification, SMRA consistently improves performance (e.g., +0.9 and +1.5 F1, respectively) while substantially enhancing explanation faithfulness, increasing IoU F1 (+7.4 pp) and Token F1 (+5.0 pp). Although explanations become more concise, sufficiency improves (+2.3 pp) and fairness remains stable, indicating more faithful rationales without performance or bias trade-offs

title: Personalization of Large Foundation Models for Health Interventions
comments: Accepted to the AAAI 2026 Workshop on Personalization in the Era of Large Foundation Models (PerFM)
summary: Large foundation models (LFMs) transform healthcare AI in prevention, diagnostics, and treatment. However, whether LFMs can provide truly personalized treatment recommendations remains an open question. Recent research has revealed multiple challenges for personalization, including the fundamental generalizability paradox: models achieving high accuracy in one clinical study perform at chance level in others, demonstrating that personalization and external validity exist in tension. This exemplifies broader contradictions in AI-driven healthcare: the privacy-performance paradox, scale-specificity paradox, and the automation-empathy paradox. As another challenge, the degree of causal understanding required for personalized recommendations, as opposed to mere predictive capacities of LFMs, remains an open question. N-of-1 trials -- crossover self-experiments and the gold standard for individual causal inference in personalized medicine -- resolve these tensions by providing within-person causal evidence while preserving privacy through local experimentation. Despite their impressive capabilities, this paper argues that LFMs cannot replace N-of-1 trials. We argue that LFMs and N-of-1 trials are complementary: LFMs excel at rapid hypothesis generation from population patterns using multimodal data, while N-of-1 trials excel at causal validation for a given individual. We propose a hybrid framework that combines the strengths of both to enable personalization and navigate the identified paradoxes: LFMs generate ranked intervention candidates with uncertainty estimates, which trigger subsequent N-of-1 trials. Clarifying the boundary between prediction and causation and explicitly addressing the paradoxical tensions are essential for responsible AI integration in personalized medicine.
comment: Accepted to the AAAI 2026 Workshop on Personalization in the Era of Large Foundation Models (PerFM)

title: CALM: Culturally Self-Aware Language Models
summary: Cultural awareness in language models is the capacity to understand and adapt to diverse cultural contexts. However, most existing approaches treat culture as static background knowledge, overlooking its dynamic and evolving nature. This limitation reduces their reliability in downstream tasks that demand genuine cultural sensitivity. In this work, we introduce CALM, a novel framework designed to endow language models with cultural self-awareness. CALM disentangles task semantics from explicit cultural concepts and latent cultural signals, shaping them into structured cultural clusters through contrastive learning. These clusters are then aligned via cross-attention to establish fine-grained interactions among related cultural features and are adaptively integrated through a Mixture-of-Experts mechanism along culture-specific dimensions. The resulting unified representation is fused with the model's original knowledge to construct a culturally grounded internal identity state, which is further enhanced through self-prompted reflective learning, enabling continual adaptation and self-correction. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple cross-cultural benchmark datasets demonstrate that CALM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

title: From Bits to Chips: An LLM-based Hardware-Aware Quantization Agent for Streamlined Deployment of LLMs
summary: Deploying models, especially large language models (LLMs), is becoming increasingly attractive to a broader user base, including those without specialized expertise. However, due to the resource constraints of certain hardware, maintaining high accuracy with larger model while meeting the hardware requirements remains a significant challenge. Model quantization technique helps mitigate memory and compute bottlenecks, yet the added complexities of tuning and deploying quantized models further exacerbates these challenges, making the process unfriendly to most of the users. We introduce the Hardware-Aware Quantization Agent (HAQA), an automated framework that leverages LLMs to streamline the entire quantization and deployment process by enabling efficient hyperparameter tuning and hardware configuration, thereby simultaneously improving deployment quality and ease of use for a broad range of users. Our results demonstrate up to a 2.3x speedup in inference, along with increased throughput and improved accuracy compared to unoptimized models on Llama. Additionally, HAQA is designed to implement adaptive quantization strategies across diverse hardware platforms, as it automatically finds optimal settings even when they appear counterintuitive, thereby reducing extensive manual effort and demonstrating superior adaptability. Code will be released.

title: Adaptive Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Orbit Feedback Control in NSLS-II Storage Ring
comments: Accepted by the 20th International Conference on Accelerator and Large Experimental Physics Control Systems (ICALEPCS 2025)
summary: The National Synchrotron Light Source II (NSLS-II) uses highly stable electron beam to produce high-quality X-ray beams with high brightness and low-emittance synchrotron radiation. The traditional algorithm to stabilize the beam applies singular value decomposition (SVD) on the orbit response matrix to remove noise and extract actions. Supervised learning has been studied on NSLS-II storage ring stabilization and other accelerator facilities recently. Several problems, for example, machine status drifting, environment noise, and non-linear accelerator dynamics, remain unresolved in the SVD-based and supervised learning algorithms. To address these problems, we propose an adaptive training framework based on model-based reinforcement learning. This framework consists of two types of optimizations: trajectory optimization attempts to minimize the expected total reward in a differentiable environment, and online model optimization learns non-linear machine dynamics through the agent-environment interaction. Through online training, this framework tracks the internal status drifting in the electron beam ring. Simulation and real in-facility experiments on NSLS-II reveal that our method stabilizes the beam position and minimizes the alignment error, defined as the root mean square (RMS) error between adjusted beam positions and the reference position, down to ~1$μ$m.
comment: Accepted by the 20th International Conference on Accelerator and Large Experimental Physics Control Systems (ICALEPCS 2025)

title: LCPs of Subspace Codes
summary: A subspace code is a nonempty collection of subspaces of the vector space $\mathbb{F}_q^{n}$. A pair of linear codes is called a linear complementary pair (in short LCP) of codes if their intersection is trivial and the sum of their dimensions equals the dimension of the ambient space. Equivalently, the two codes form an LCP if the direct sum of these two codes is equal to the entire space. In this paper, we introduce the concept of LCPs of subspace codes. We first provide a characterization of subspace codes that form an LCP. Furthermore, we present a sufficient condition for the existence of an LCP of subspace codes based on a complement function on a subspace code. In addition, we give several constructions of LCPs for subspace codes using various techniques and provide an application to insertion error correction.

title: CroBIM-U: Uncertainty-Driven Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
summary: Referring remote sensing image segmentation aims to localize specific targets described by natural language within complex overhead imagery. However, due to extreme scale variations, dense similar distractors, and intricate boundary structures, the reliability of cross-modal alignment exhibits significant \textbf{spatial non-uniformity}. Existing methods typically employ uniform fusion and refinement strategies across the entire image, which often introduces unnecessary linguistic perturbations in visually clear regions while failing to provide sufficient disambiguation in confused areas. To address this, we propose an \textbf{uncertainty-guided framework} that explicitly leverages a pixel-wise \textbf{referring uncertainty map} as a spatial prior to orchestrate adaptive inference. Specifically, we introduce a plug-and-play \textbf{Referring Uncertainty Scorer (RUS)}, which is trained via an online error-consistency supervision strategy to interpretably predict the spatial distribution of referential ambiguity. Building on this prior, we design two plug-and-play modules: 1) \textbf{Uncertainty-Gated Fusion (UGF)}, which dynamically modulates language injection strength to enhance constraints in high-uncertainty regions while suppressing noise in low-uncertainty ones; and 2) \textbf{Uncertainty-Driven Local Refinement (UDLR)}, which utilizes uncertainty-derived soft masks to focus refinement on error-prone boundaries and fine details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method functions as a unified, plug-and-play solution that significantly improves robustness and geometric fidelity in complex remote sensing scenes without altering the backbone architecture.

title: Hermitian LCD $2$-Quasi Abelian Codes over Finite Chain Rings
summary: This paper introduces a class of Hermitian LCD $2$-quasi-abelian codes over finite fields and presents a comprehensive enumeration of these codes in which relative minimum weights are small. We show that such codes are asymptotically good over finite fields. Furthermore, we extend our analysis to finite chain rings by characterizing $2$-quasi-abelian codes in this setting and proving the existence of asymptotically good Hermitian LCD $2$-quasi-abelian codes over finite chain rings as well.

title: Submodular Evaluation Subset Selection in Automatic Prompt Optimization
summary: Automatic prompt optimization reduces manual prompt engineering, but relies on task performance measured on a small, often randomly sampled evaluation subset as its main source of feedback signal. Despite this, how to select that evaluation subset is usually treated as an implementation detail. We study evaluation subset selection for prompt optimization from a principled perspective and propose SESS, a submodular evaluation subset selection method. We frame selection as maximizing an objective set function and show that, under mild conditions, it is monotone and submodular, enabling greedy selection with theoretical guarantees. Across GSM8K, MATH, and GPQA-Diamond, submodularly selected evaluation subsets can yield better optimized prompts than random or heuristic baselines.

title: Cyberattack Detection in Virtualized Microgrids Using LightGBM and Knowledge-Distilled Classifiers
summary: Modern microgrids depend on distributed sensing and communication interfaces, making them increasingly vulnerable to cyber physical disturbances that threaten operational continuity and equipment safety. In this work, a complete virtual microgrid was designed and implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, integrating heterogeneous renewable sources and secondary controller layers. A structured cyberattack framework was developed using MGLib to inject adversarial signals directly into the secondary control pathways. Multiple attack classes were emulated, including ramp, sinusoidal, additive, coordinated stealth, and denial of service behaviors. The virtual environment was used to generate labeled datasets under both normal and attack conditions. The datasets trained Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) models to perform two functions: detecting the presence of an intrusion (binary) and distinguishing among attack types (multiclass). The multiclass model attained 99.72% accuracy and a 99.62% F1 score, while the binary model attained 94.8% accuracy and a 94.3% F1 score. A knowledge-distillation step reduced the size of the multiclass model, allowing faster predictions with only a small drop in performance. Real-time tests showed a processing delay of about 54 to 67 ms per 1000 samples, demonstrating suitability for CPU-based edge deployment in microgrid controllers. The results confirm that lightweight machine learning based intrusion detection methods can provide fast, accurate, and efficient cyberattack detection without relying on complex deep learning models. Key contributions include: (1) development of a complete MATLAB-based virtual microgrid, (2) structured attack injection at the control layer, (3) creation of multiclass labeled datasets, and (4) design of low-cost AI models suitable for practical microgrid cybersecurity.

title: STELLA: Self-Reflective Terminology-Aware Framework for Building an Aerospace Information Retrieval Benchmark
summary: Tasks in the aerospace industry heavily rely on searching and reusing large volumes of technical documents, yet there is no public information retrieval (IR) benchmark that reflects the terminology- and query-intent characteristics of this domain. To address this gap, this paper proposes the STELLA (Self-Reflective TErminoLogy-Aware Framework for BuiLding an Aerospace Information Retrieval Benchmark) framework. Using this framework, we introduce the STELLA benchmark, an aerospace-specific IR evaluation set constructed from NASA Technical Reports Server (NTRS) documents via a systematic pipeline that comprises document layout detection, passage chunking, terminology dictionary construction, synthetic query generation, and cross-lingual extension. The framework generates two types of queries: the Terminology Concordant Query (TCQ), which includes the terminology verbatim to evaluate lexical matching, and the Terminology Agnostic Query (TAQ), which utilizes the terminology's description to assess semantic matching. This enables a disentangled evaluation of the lexical and semantic matching capabilities of embedding models. In addition, we combine Chain-of-Density (CoD) and the Self-Reflection method with query generation to improve quality and implement a hybrid cross-lingual extension that reflects real user querying practices. Evaluation of seven embedding models on the STELLA benchmark shows that large decoder-based embedding models exhibit the strongest semantic understanding, while lexical matching methods such as BM25 remain highly competitive in domains where exact lexical matching technical term is crucial. The STELLA benchmark provides a reproducible foundation for reliable performance evaluation and improvement of embedding models in aerospace-domain IR tasks. The STELLA benchmark can be found in https://huggingface.co/datasets/telepix/STELLA.

title: SDCD: Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate significant progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet object hallucination remains a critical challenge. While existing research focuses on mitigating language priors or high-level statistical biases, they often overlook the internal complexities of the visual encoding process. We identify that visual statistical bias, arising from the inherent Bag-of-Patches behavior of Vision Encoders under weak structural supervision, acts as a contributing factor of object hallucinations. Under this bias, models prioritize local texture features within individual patches over holistic geometric structures. This tendency may induce spurious visual confidence and result in hallucinations. To address this, we introduce a training-free algorithm called Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding (SDCD), which performs contrastive calibration of the output distribution by introducing a shuffled structure-disrupted view. By penalizing tokens that maintain high confidence under this structure-less view, SDCD effectively suppresses the texture-driven bias. Experimental results demonstrate that SDCD significantly mitigates hallucinations across multiple benchmarks and enhances the overall multimodal capabilities of LVLMs.

title: Full-Stack Knowledge Graph and LLM Framework for Post-Quantum Cyber Readiness
summary: The emergence of large-scale quantum computing threatens widely deployed public-key cryptographic systems, creating an urgent need for enterprise-level methods to assess post-quantum (PQ) readiness. While PQ standards are under development, organizations lack scalable and quantitative frameworks for measuring cryptographic exposure and prioritizing migration across complex infrastructures. This paper presents a knowledge graph based framework that models enterprise cryptographic assets, dependencies, and vulnerabilities to compute a unified PQ readiness score. Infrastructure components, cryptographic primitives, certificates, and services are represented as a heterogeneous graph, enabling explicit modeling of dependency-driven risk propagation. PQ exposure is quantified using graph-theoretic risk functionals and attributed across cryptographic domains via Shapley value decomposition. To support scalability and data quality, the framework integrates large language models with human-in-the-loop validation for asset classification and risk attribution. The resulting approach produces explainable, normalized readiness metrics that support continuous monitoring, comparative analysis, and remediation prioritization.

title: Beyond Perplexity: A Lightweight Benchmark for Knowledge Retention in Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is a standard approach for injecting domain knowledge into Large Language Models (LLMs). However, relying on validation perplexity to monitor training is often insufficient, as it confounds stylistic mimicry with genuine factual internalization. To address this, we introduce the Knowledge Retention (KR) Test , a lightweight, corpus-grounded evaluation framework designed to distinguish factual learning from linguistics. KR-Test utilizes automatically generated contrastive examples to measure likelihood preferences for correct versus incorrect continuations, requiring no instruction tuning or generative decoding. We validate the framework's integrity through a "blind vs. oracle" baseline analysis. Furthermore, we demonstrate the diagnostic capabilities of KR-Test by analyzing the training dynamics of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). By exposing the fine-grained dissociation between linguistic convergence and knowledge retention, KR-Test enhances the interpretability of fine-tuning dynamics.

title: Reasoning Pattern Alignment Merging for Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Recent large reasoning models (LRMs) have made substantial progress in complex reasoning tasks, yet they often generate lengthy reasoning paths for every query, incurring unnecessary computation and latency. Existing speed-up approaches typically rely on retraining the model or designing sophisticated prompting, which are either prohibitively expensive or highly sensitive to the input and prompt formulation. In this work, we study model merging as a lightweight alternative for efficient reasoning: by combining a long chain-of-thought (Long-CoT) reasoning model with a Short-CoT instruction model, we obtain an adaptive reasoner without training from scratch or requiring large-scale additional data. Building on this idea, we propose Reasoning Pattern Alignment Merging (RPAM), a layer-wise model merging framework based on feature alignment to facilitate query-adaptive reasoning. RPAM first constructs a small pattern-labeled calibration set that assigns each query an appropriate reasoning pattern. It then optimizes layer-wise merging coefficients by aligning the merged model's intermediate representations with those of the selected model, while a contrastive objective explicitly pushes them away from the non-selected model. Experiments on seven widely used reasoning benchmarks show that RPAM substantially reduces inference cost while maintaining strong performance. Upon article acceptance, we will provide open-source code to reproduce experiments for RPAM.

title: REFA: Real-time Egocentric Facial Animations for Virtual Reality
summary: We present a novel system for real-time tracking of facial expressions using egocentric views captured from a set of infrared cameras embedded in a virtual reality (VR) headset. Our technology facilitates any user to accurately drive the facial expressions of virtual characters in a non-intrusive manner and without the need of a lengthy calibration step. At the core of our system is a distillation based approach to train a machine learning model on heterogeneous data and labels coming form multiple sources, \eg synthetic and real images. As part of our dataset, we collected 18k diverse subjects using a lightweight capture setup consisting of a mobile phone and a custom VR headset with extra cameras. To process this data, we developed a robust differentiable rendering pipeline enabling us to automatically extract facial expression labels. Our system opens up new avenues for communication and expression in virtual environments, with applications in video conferencing, gaming, entertainment, and remote collaboration.

title: A Critical Analysis of the Medibank Health Data Breach and Differential Privacy Solutions
summary: This paper critically examines the 2022 Medibank health insurance data breach, which exposed sensitive medical records of 9.7 million individuals due to unencrypted storage, centralized access, and the absence of privacy-preserving analytics. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose an entropy-aware differential privacy (DP) framework that integrates Laplace and Gaussian mechanisms with adaptive budget allocation. The design incorporates TLS-encrypted database access, field-level mechanism selection, and smooth sensitivity models to mitigate re-identification risks. Experimental validation was conducted using synthetic Medibank datasets (N = 131,000) with entropy-calibrated DP mechanisms, where high-entropy attributes received stronger noise injection. Results demonstrate a 90.3% reduction in re-identification probability while maintaining analytical utility loss below 24%. The framework further aligns with GDPR Article 32 and Australian Privacy Principle 11.1, ensuring regulatory compliance. By combining rigorous privacy guarantees with practical usability, this work contributes a scalable and technically feasible solution for healthcare data protection, offering a pathway toward resilient, trustworthy, and regulation-ready medical analytics.

title: Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks
summary: We study continual skill acquisition in open-ended embodied environments where an agent must construct, refine, and reuse an expanding library of executable skills. We introduce the Programmatic Skill Network (PSN), a framework in which skills are executable symbolic programs forming a compositional network that evolves through experience. PSN defines three core mechanisms instantiated via large language models: (1)REFLECT for structured fault localization over skill compositions, (2) progressive optimization with maturity-aware update gating that stabilizes reliable skills while maintaining plasticity for uncertain ones, and (3) canonical structural refactoring under rollback validation that maintains network compactness. We further show that PSN's learning dynamics exhibit structural parallels to neural network training. Experiments on MineDojo and Crafter demonstrate robust skill reuse, rapid adaptation, and strong generalization across open-ended task distributions.\footnote{We plan to open-source the code.

title: G2P: Gaussian-to-Point Attribute Alignment for Boundary-Aware 3D Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation on point clouds is critical for 3D scene understanding. However, sparse and irregular point distributions provide limited appearance evidence, making geometry-only features insufficient to distinguish objects with similar shapes but distinct appearances (e.g., color, texture, material). We propose Gaussian-to-Point (G2P), which transfers appearance-aware attributes from 3D Gaussian Splatting to point clouds for more discriminative and appearance-consistent segmentation. Our G2P address the misalignment between optimized Gaussians and original point geometry by establishing point-wise correspondences. By leveraging Gaussian opacity attributes, we resolve the geometric ambiguity that limits existing models. Additionally, Gaussian scale attributes enable precise boundary localization in complex 3D scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance on standard benchmarks and shows significant improvements on geometrically challenging classes, all without any 2D or language supervision.

title: IntroLM: Introspective Language Models via Prefilling-Time Self-Evaluation
summary: A major challenge for the operation of large language models (LLMs) is how to predict whether a specific LLM will produce sufficiently high-quality output for a given query. Existing approaches rely on external classifiers, most commonly BERT based models, which suffer from limited context windows, constrained representational capacity, and additional computational overhead. We propose IntroLM, a method that enables causal language models to predict their own output quality during the prefilling phase without affecting generation using introspective tokens. By introducing token conditional LoRA that activates only for the introspective token, the model learns to predict the output quality for a given query while preserving the original backbone behavior and avoiding external evaluators. On question answering benchmarks, IntroLM applied to Qwen3 8B achieves a ROC AUC of 90 precent for success prediction, outperforming a DeBERTa classifier by 14 precent. When integrated into multi model routing systems, IntroLM achieves superior cost performance tradeoffs, reducing latency by up to 33 precent and large model usage by up to 50 precent at matched reliability.

title: Bootstrapping Code Translation with Weighted Multilanguage Exploration
summary: Code translation across multiple programming languages is essential yet challenging due to two vital obstacles: scarcity of parallel data paired with executable test oracles, and optimization imbalance when handling diverse language pairs. We propose BootTrans, a bootstrapping method that resolves both obstacles. Its key idea is to leverage the functional invariance and cross-lingual portability of test suites, adapting abundant pivot-language unit tests to serve as universal verification oracles for multilingual RL training. Our method introduces a dual-pool architecture with seed and exploration pools to progressively expand training data via execution-guided experience collection. Furthermore, we design a language-aware weighting mechanism that dynamically prioritizes harder translation directions based on relative performance across sibling languages, mitigating optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on the HumanEval-X and TransCoder-Test benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline LLMs across all translation directions, with ablations validating the effectiveness of both bootstrapping and weighting components.

title: Deploy-Master: Automating the Deployment of 50,000+ Agent-Ready Scientific Tools in One Day
summary:
Open-source scientific software is abundant, yet most tools remain difficult to compile, configure, and reuse, sustaining a small-workshop mode of scientific computing. This deployment bottleneck limits reproducibility, large-scale evaluation, and the practical integration of scientific tools into modern AI-for-Science (AI4S) and agentic workflows.
  We present Deploy-Master, a one-stop agentic workflow for large-scale tool discovery, build specification inference, execution-based validation, and publication. Guided by a taxonomy spanning 90+ scientific and engineering domains, our discovery stage starts from a recall-oriented pool of over 500,000 public repositories and progressively filters it to 52,550 executable tool candidates under license- and quality-aware criteria. Deploy-Master transforms heterogeneous open-source repositories into runnable, containerized capabilities grounded in execution rather than documentation claims. In a single day, we performed 52,550 build attempts and constructed reproducible runtime environments for 50,112 scientific tools. Each successful tool is validated by a minimal executable command and registered in SciencePedia for search and reuse, enabling direct human use and optional agent-based invocation.
  Beyond delivering runnable tools, we report a deployment trace at the scale of 50,000 tools, characterizing throughput, cost profiles, failure surfaces, and specification uncertainty that become visible only at scale. These results explain why scientific software remains difficult to operationalize and motivate shared, observable execution substrates as a foundation for scalable AI4S and agentic science.

title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is a critical capability for multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents, particularly in conversational settings where information accumulates and evolves over time. However, existing benchmarks either evaluate multi-session memory in text-only conversations or assess multimodal understanding within localized contexts, failing to evaluate how multimodal memory is preserved, organized, and evolved across long-term conversational trajectories. Thus, we introduce Mem-Gallery, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents. Mem-Gallery features high-quality multi-session conversations grounded in both visual and textual information, with long interaction horizons and rich multimodal dependencies. Building on this dataset, we propose a systematic evaluation framework that assesses key memory capabilities along three functional dimensions: memory extraction and test-time adaptation, memory reasoning, and memory knowledge management. Extensive benchmarking across thirteen memory systems reveals several key findings, highlighting the necessity of explicit multimodal information retention and memory organization, the persistent limitations in memory reasoning and knowledge management, as well as the efficiency bottleneck of current models.

AI.title_translation: Mem-Gallery：面向多模态大语言模型智能体的多模态长期对话记忆基准测试
AI.tldr: 引入了一个名为 Mem-Gallery 的新基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体的长期多模态对话记忆能力。该基准包含基于视觉和文本信息的多轮对话，并提出了一个三维度的评估框架。基准测试显示，现有模型在记忆推理、知识管理和效率方面存在显著限制。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体在信息积累和演变的对话环境中至关重要的能力。然而，现有基准要么只评估纯文本对话中的多轮记忆，要么只在局部上下文中评估多模态理解，无法评估多模态记忆如何在长期对话轨迹中被保存、组织和演变。
AI.method: 引入了 Mem-Gallery 基准，该基准包含高质量、多轮次、基于视觉和文本信息且具有长交互范围和丰富多模态依赖关系的对话数据。在此基础上，提出了一个系统的评估框架，从三个功能维度评估关键记忆能力：记忆提取和测试时适应、记忆推理以及记忆知识管理。
AI.result: 对十三种记忆系统进行了广泛的基准测试，揭示了几个关键发现：强调了显式多模态信息保留和记忆组织的必要性；指出了模型在记忆推理和知识管理方面持续存在的局限性；以及当前模型的效率瓶颈。
AI.translation: 长期记忆是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体的一项关键能力，尤其是在信息随时间积累和演变的对话环境中。然而，现有基准要么评估纯文本对话中的多轮记忆，要么在局部上下文中评估多模态理解，未能评估多模态记忆如何在长期对话轨迹中被保存、组织和演变。因此，我们引入了 Mem-Gallery，这是一个用于评估 MLLM 智能体多模态长期对话记忆的新基准。Mem-Gallery 具有高质量、基于视觉和文本信息的多轮对话，具备长交互范围和丰富的多模态依赖关系。基于此数据集，我们提出了一个系统的评估框架，从三个功能维度评估关键记忆能力：记忆提取和测试时适应、记忆推理以及记忆知识管理。对十三种记忆系统进行的广泛基准测试揭示了几个关键发现，突显了显式多模态信息保留和记忆组织的必要性、记忆推理和知识管理方面持续存在的局限性，以及当前模型的效率瓶颈。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 Mem-Gallery，这是一个专门用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体长期多模态对话记忆的新型基准。鉴于现有基准在评估跨长期对话轨迹的多模态记忆保存和演变方面的不足，Mem-Gallery 提供了高质量、多轮次、且结合视觉和文本信息的对话数据。研究者还提出了一个系统的评估框架，从记忆提取/适应、记忆推理和记忆知识管理三个维度进行评估。对十三种记忆系统的基准测试结果表明，当前模型需要显式的多模态信息保留和组织，并且在记忆推理、知识管理能力及效率上存在显著限制。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM), 长期记忆, 对话系统, 基准测试, Mem-Gallery
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于填补了现有基准在评估 MLLM 智能体长期多模态对话记忆方面的空白。它不仅提出了一个具有复杂多模态依赖和长期交互特征的高质量数据集 (Mem-Gallery)，还定义了一个系统的三维评估框架（提取/适应、推理、知识管理）。这为未来研究多模态智能体的记忆机制提供了标准化的工具和清晰的挑战方向，特别是揭示了现有模型在记忆组织、复杂推理和效率方面的不足。

title: Linear-Time $(1+\varepsilon)$-Approximation Algorithms for Two-Line-Center Problems
summary: Given a set $S$ of $n$ points in the plane, we study the two-line-center problem: finding two lines that minimize the maximum distance from each point in $S$ to its closest line. We present a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for the two-line-center problem that runs in $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$ time, which improves the previously best $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$-time algorithm. We also consider three variants of this problem, in which the orientations of the two lines are restricted: (1) the orientation of one of the two lines is fixed, (2) the orientations of both lines are fixed, and (3) the two lines are required to be parallel. For each of these three variants, we give the first $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm that runs in linear time. In particular, for the variant where the orientation of one of the two lines is fixed, we also give an improved exact algorithm that runs in $O(n \log n)$ time and show that it is optimal.

AI.title_translation: 两线中心问题的线性时间 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法
AI.tldr: 提出了解决平面上两线中心问题的快速 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，将主问题的运行时间改进到 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$。对于三个受限变体问题，首次实现了线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，其中一个变体还给出了最优的精确算法。
AI.motivation: 研究两线中心问题，即找到两条线，使平面上所有点到其最近线的最大距离最小化。目的是改进现有算法的运行时间，特别是寻求更快的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。
AI.method: 提出了 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。具体方法细节（如使用的几何技术或数据结构）摘要中未提及，但通过分析和改进实现了显著优化的时间复杂度。
AI.result: 1. 对于主两线中心问题，给出了运行时间为 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$ 的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，改进了先前最优的 $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$ 时间算法。2. 对于三个受限变体问题（一条线方向固定、两条线方向均固定、两条线平行），首次给出了线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。3. 对于其中一条线方向固定的变体，还给出了运行时间为 $O(n \log n)$ 的改进精确算法，并证明了其最优性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功地为两线中心问题及其受限变体提供了显著改进的、接近线性的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，其中一些结果达到了时间最优性。
AI.translation: 给定平面上 $n$ 个点的集合 $S$，我们研究两线中心问题：找到两条线，以最小化集合 $S$ 中每个点到其最近线的最大距离。我们为两线中心问题提出了一个运行时间为 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$ 的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，这改进了先前最优的 $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$ 时间算法。我们还考虑了该问题的三个变体，其中两条线的方向受到限制：（1）两条线中一条线的方向是固定的，（2）两条线的方向都是固定的，以及（3）要求两条线平行。对于这三个变体中的每一个，我们都给出了第一个运行时间为线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。特别是，对于其中一条线方向固定的变体，我们还给出了一个运行时间为 $O(n \log n)$ 的改进精确算法，并表明它是最优的。
AI.summary: 本文研究平面上的两线中心问题及其三个方向受限的变体。对于主问题，提出了一种运行时间为 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$ 的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，显著优于现有算法。对于所有三个受限变体（一条线方向固定、两条线方向均固定、两条线平行），首次实现了线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。此外，对于一条线方向固定的变体，还提供了一个最优的 $O(n \log n)$ 精确算法。
AI.keywords: 两线中心问题, 近似算法, 线性时间, 计算几何
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于大幅提升了两线中心问题的近似算法效率，将运行时间从依赖于 $\varepsilon$ 的高阶多项式项改进到接近线性的 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$。对于受限变体问题，首次实现了理论上非常理想的线性时间近似算法，这在计算几何和设施选址问题中具有重要意义。特别是，对一个变体给出了最优的精确解，显示了算法设计的彻底性。

title: Semantic Belief-State World Model for 3D Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction has traditionally been framed as a sequence regression problem where models extrapolate future joint coordinates from observed pose histories. While effective over short horizons this approach does not separate observation reconstruction with dynamics modeling and offers no explicit representation of the latent causes governing motion. As a result, existing methods exhibit compounding drift, mean-pose collapse, and poorly calibrated uncertainty when rolled forward beyond the training regime. Here we propose a Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) that reframes human motion prediction as latent dynamical simulation on the human body manifold. Rather than predicting poses directly, SBWM maintains a recurrent probabilistic belief state whose evolution is learned independently of pose reconstruction and explicitly aligned with the SMPL-X anatomical parameterization. This alignment imposes a structural information bottleneck that prevents the latent state from encoding static geometry or sensor noise, forcing it to capture motion dynamics, intent, and control-relevant structure. Inspired by belief-state world models developed for model-based reinforcement learning, SBWM adapts stochastic latent transitions and rollout-centric training to the domain of human motion. In contrast to RSSM-based, transformer, and diffusion approaches optimized for reconstruction fidelity, SBWM prioritizes stable forward simulation. We demonstrate coherent long-horizon rollouts, and competitive accuracy at substantially lower computational cost. These results suggest that treating the human body as part of the world models state space rather than its output fundamentally changes how motion is simulated, and predicted.

AI.title_translation: 3D人体运动预测的语义信念状态世界模型
AI.tldr: 针对传统人体运动预测长期不稳定的问题，本文提出语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM）。它将运动建模为与SMPL-X结构对齐的潜在动力学，分离了动态建模与姿势重建，实现了稳定、长期的运动模拟，且计算成本较低。
AI.motivation: 传统的运动预测方法将问题框架为序列回归，该方法未能将观测重建与动力学建模分离，缺乏对运动潜在原因的明确表示，导致在长期预测中出现累积漂移、平均姿势崩溃和校准不良的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM）。该模型将人体运动预测重新定义为在人体流形上的潜在动力学模拟。SBWM维护一个循环概率信念状态，其演化独立于姿势重建学习，并明确与SMPL-X解剖参数化对齐。它借鉴了基于模型的强化学习中的信念状态世界模型，采用随机潜在转换和以展开为中心的训练，优先考虑稳定的前向模拟。
AI.result: 实现了连贯的长期展开模拟，与基于RSSM、Transformer和扩散的方法相比，在显著较低的计算成本下获得了具有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: 将人体视为世界模型状态空间的一部分而不是其输出，从根本上改变了运动的模拟和预测方式。
AI.translation: 人体运动预测传统上被框架为一个序列回归问题，模型从观察到的姿势历史中外推未来的关节坐标。尽管在短期内有效，但这种方法没有将观测重建与动力学建模分离，也没有提供控制运动的潜在原因的明确表示。结果，现有方法在超出训练范围进行前向滚动时，表现出累积漂移、平均姿势崩溃和校准不良的不确定性。在这里，我们提出了一个语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM），它将人体运动预测重新定义为人体流形上的潜在动力学模拟。SBWM不是直接预测姿势，而是维护一个循环概率信念状态，其演化独立于姿势重建学习，并明确与SMPL-X解剖参数化对齐。这种对齐施加了一个结构性信息瓶颈，阻止潜在状态编码静态几何或传感器噪声，迫使其捕获运动动力学、意图和控制相关结构。受为基于模型的强化学习开发的信念状态世界模型的启发，SBWM将随机潜在转换和以展开为中心的训练应用于人体运动领域。与优化重建保真度的基于RSSM、Transformer和扩散方法相反，SBWM优先考虑稳定的前向模拟。我们展示了连贯的长期展开模拟，以及在显著较低计算成本下的竞争力精度。这些结果表明，将人体视为世界模型状态空间的一部分而不是其输出，从根本上改变了运动的模拟和预测方式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于3D人体运动预测的语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM）。SBWM通过引入一个与SMPL-X参数明确对齐的循环概率信念状态，将问题从序列回归重新定义为潜在动力学模拟。这种结构对齐将动力学建模与姿势重建分离，有效解决了传统方法中的累积漂移和平均姿势崩溃等问题。受强化学习世界模型的启发，SBWM优先考虑稳定的前向模拟，实现了连贯的长期预测，同时具有竞争力的精度和较低的计算成本。
AI.keywords: 语义信念状态世界模型, 人体运动预测, 潜在动力学, SMPL-X, 世界模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于将强化学习中的世界模型（特别是信念状态模型）引入人体运动预测领域。关键的创新点是通过将潜在状态与SMPL-X解剖参数明确对齐，施加了一个结构性信息瓶颈。这迫使模型捕获纯粹的运动动力学和意图，从而实现了对运动的稳定、长期模拟，克服了传统上以重建为中心的模型容易出现的漂移和崩溃问题。同时，该方法在保持竞争性精度的前提下显著降低了计算成本，具有重要的实际意义。

title: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Visual Prompt for OFF-Road Autonomous Driving
summary: Efficient trajectory planning in off-road terrains presents a formidable challenge for autonomous vehicles, often necessitating complex multi-step pipelines. However, traditional approaches exhibit limited adaptability in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, this paper proposes OFF-EMMA, a novel end-to-end multimodal framework designed to overcome the deficiencies of insufficient spatial perception and unstable reasoning in visual-language-action (VLA) models for off-road autonomous driving scenarios. The framework explicitly annotates input images through the design of a visual prompt block and introduces a chain-of-thought with self-consistency (COT-SC) reasoning strategy to enhance the accuracy and robustness of trajectory planning. The visual prompt block utilizes semantic segmentation masks as visual prompts, enhancing the spatial understanding ability of pre-trained visual-language models for complex terrains. The COT- SC strategy effectively mitigates the error impact of outliers on planning performance through a multi-path reasoning mechanism. Experimental results on the RELLIS-3D off-road dataset demonstrate that OFF-EMMA significantly outperforms existing methods, reducing the average L2 error of the Qwen backbone model by 13.3% and decreasing the failure rate from 16.52% to 6.56%.

AI.title_translation: 带有视觉提示的越野自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: 针对越野自动驾驶中 VLA 模型空间感知不足和推理不稳定的问题，本文提出了端到端多模态框架 OFF-EMMA。它通过设计视觉提示块（使用语义分割掩码）和引入带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链推理策略，显著提高了轨迹规划的精度和鲁棒性，在 RELLIS-3D 数据集上将故障率从 16.52% 降至 6.56%。
AI.motivation: 越野地形的高效轨迹规划对自动驾驶车辆构成严峻挑战，传统方法通常复杂且在动态环境中适应性有限。现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在越野自动驾驶场景中存在空间感知不足和推理不稳定的缺陷。
AI.method:
本文提出了 OFF-EMMA 框架，这是一个端到端的多模态框架，旨在增强轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性。该方法包含两个关键策略：
1. **视觉提示块（Visual Prompt Block）**：通过设计该模块来显式标注输入图像，利用语义分割掩码作为视觉提示，增强预训练视觉-语言模型对复杂地形的空间理解能力。
2. **带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链推理策略**：通过多路径推理机制，有效减轻异常值对规划性能的错误影响。
AI.result: 在 RELLIS-3D 越野数据集上的实验结果表明，OFF-EMMA 显著优于现有方法。它将基于 Qwen 主干模型的平均 L2 误差降低了 13.3%，并将故障率从 16.52% 降低到了 6.56%。
AI.translation: 越野地形中的高效轨迹规划对自动驾驶车辆提出了严峻的挑战，通常需要复杂的、多步骤的流程。然而，传统方法在动态环境中的适应性有限。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了 OFF-EMMA，这是一种新颖的端到端多模态框架，旨在克服越野自动驾驶场景中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型空间感知不足和推理不稳定的缺陷。该框架通过设计视觉提示块来显式标注输入图像，并引入带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链推理策略，以提高轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性。视觉提示块利用语义分割掩码作为视觉提示，增强了预训练视觉-语言模型对复杂地形的空间理解能力。COT-SC 策略通过多路径推理机制，有效地减轻了异常值对规划性能的错误影响。在 RELLIS-3D 越野数据集上的实验结果表明，OFF-EMMA 显著优于现有方法，将 Qwen 主干模型的平均 L2 误差降低了 13.3%，并将故障率从 16.52% 降低到了 6.56%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 OFF-EMMA，一个用于越野自动驾驶的端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）多模态框架，以解决现有 VLA 模型在复杂地形中空间感知不足和推理不稳定的问题。OFF-EMMA 的核心创新在于引入了利用语义分割掩码的视觉提示块，以及基于多路径推理的带有自洽性（COT-SC）的思维链策略。实验证明，该方法在 RELLIS-3D 越野数据集上显著提高了轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性，大幅降低了 L2 误差和故障率。
AI.keywords: 越野自动驾驶, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 视觉提示, 思维链, 轨迹规划
AI.comments: OFF-EMMA 的创新点在于将两种强大的机制——视觉提示（利用明确的语义信息）和带有自洽性的思维链（用于稳定推理）——结合到一个端到端的 VLA 框架中，专门解决越野这一高难度场景。这种方法有效地将高级感知信息（语义分割）直接注入到 VLA 模型中，弥补了其在空间理解上的不足，并通过多路径推理机制提高了决策的可靠性。其在 L2 误差和故障率上的显著改善，证明了该框架在实际应用中的潜力和重要性。

title: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Model for Mapping and Goal-Directed Navigation Using Multiscale Place Fields
comments: 11 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems
summary: Autonomous navigation in complex and partially observable environments remains a central challenge in robotics. Several bio-inspired models of mapping and navigation based on place cells in the mammalian hippocampus have been proposed. This paper introduces a new robust model that employs parallel layers of place fields at multiple spatial scales, a replay-based reward mechanism, and dynamic scale fusion. Simulations show that the model improves path efficiency and accelerates learning compared to single-scale baselines, highlighting the value of multiscale spatial representations for adaptive robot navigation.
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems

AI.title_translation: 基于多尺度位置场的强化学习模型，用于建图和目标导向导航。
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的基于强化学习的导航模型，该模型使用多尺度位置场、重放奖励机制和动态尺度融合，在复杂环境中提高了路径效率并加速了学习。
AI.motivation: 在复杂且部分可观察的环境中实现自主导航仍然是机器人技术的核心挑战。已有的基于哺乳动物海马体位置细胞的生物启发式模型需要改进。
AI.method: 该模型是一种新的基于强化学习的鲁棒模型，它采用了以下机制：1. 多空间尺度的并行位置场层。2. 基于重放的奖励机制。3. 动态尺度融合。
AI.result: 模拟结果显示，与单尺度基线模型相比，该模型提高了路径效率并加速了学习。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度空间表征对于自适应机器人导航具有重要价值。
AI.translation: 在复杂且部分可观察的环境中实现自主导航仍然是机器人技术的核心挑战。目前已提出了几种基于哺乳动物海马体中位置细胞的生物启发式建图和导航模型。本文介绍了一种新的鲁棒模型，该模型采用了多空间尺度的并行位置场层、基于重放的奖励机制和动态尺度融合。仿真结果表明，与单尺度基线模型相比，该模型提高了路径效率并加速了学习，突显了多尺度空间表征对于自适应机器人导航的价值。
AI.summary: 本文针对机器人在复杂环境中的自主导航挑战，提出了一种基于强化学习的新型鲁棒模型。该模型模仿生物机制，利用多尺度位置场的并行层、基于重放的奖励机制和动态尺度融合来进行建图和目标导向导航。实验仿真证明，该模型在路径效率和学习速度上均优于传统的单尺度模型。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 多尺度位置场, 目标导向导航, 动态尺度融合, 生物启发模型
AI.comments:
**创新性：** 该模型将生物学启发的多尺度位置场概念与现代强化学习（RL）技术相结合，特别是引入了“基于重放的奖励机制”和“动态尺度融合”，这在解决复杂环境下的导航问题上是重要的结合点。这种多尺度表示解决了单尺度模型在复杂和部分可观察环境中的局限性。
**重要性：** 解决了自主导航中的核心挑战，通过提高路径效率和学习速度，为更高效、更具适应性的机器人导航系统提供了理论基础和实用模型。
**局限性 (基于摘要的推测)：** 摘要中仅提及“仿真”（Simulations），未提及在真实机器人硬件上的测试或部署，这可能是该研究在实际应用中的下一步挑战。

title: A Tool for Estimating Success Rates of Raycasting-Based Object Selection in Virtual Reality
summary: As XR devices become widespread, 3D interaction has become commonplace, and UI developers are increasingly required to consider usability to deliver better user experiences. The HCI community has long studied target-pointing performance, and research on 3D environments has progressed substantially. However, for practitioners to directly leverage research findings in UI improvements, practical tools are needed. To bridge this gap between research and development in VR systems, we propose a system that estimates object selection success rates within a development tool (Unity). In this paper, we validate the underlying theory, describe the tool's functions, and report feedback from VR developers who tried the tool to assess its usefulness.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于估计虚拟现实中基于光线投射的对象选择成功率的工具
AI.tldr: 提出了一种在Unity中估计基于光线投射的VR对象选择成功率的工具，旨在帮助开发者利用HCI研究成果改善用户体验。
AI.motivation: 随着XR设备的普及，3D交互变得常见，UI开发者需要提高可用性。尽管人机交互（HCI）社区在3D环境下的目标指向性能研究取得了进展，但从业者缺乏实用的工具来直接将这些研究成果应用于UI改进中，因此需要弥合研究与开发之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出了一个系统/工具，用于在主流开发工具（Unity）中估计对象选择的成功率。该方法包括验证基础理论、描述工具功能，并通过收集VR开发者的反馈来评估其实用性。
AI.result: 报告了VR开发者试用该工具后的反馈，以评估其有用性。（具体的量化结果摘要中未提及。）
AI.translation: 随着XR设备变得普及，3D交互已司空见惯，UI开发者被要求越来越关注可用性以提供更好的用户体验。HCI社区长期以来一直在研究目标指向性能，并且在3D环境中的研究已取得实质性进展。然而，对于从业者而言，若要直接利用研究结果来改进UI，则需要实用的工具。为了弥合VR系统研究与开发之间的差距，我们提出了一个在开发工具（Unity）中估计对象选择成功率的系统。在本文中，我们验证了基础理论，描述了该工具的功能，并报告了尝试使用该工具的VR开发者的反馈，以评估其实用性。
AI.summary: 鉴于XR设备的普及和3D交互的常态化，本文旨在通过弥合HCI研究与VR开发之间的差距来提高用户体验。作者提出了一种集成在开发工具Unity中的系统，用于估计基于光线投射的对象选择的成功率。论文验证了该工具的基础理论，描述了其功能，并通过收集VR开发者的反馈来评估其实用性和价值。
AI.keywords: 虚拟现实,光线投射,对象选择,成功率估计, Unity
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将长期的HCI研究成果转化为面向实际开发者的实用工具，特别是在VR中关键的基于光线投射的对象选择任务上。通过将可用性估计功能直接集成到主流开发环境（Unity）中，它提供了一个即时、可操作的反馈机制，有助于开发者在设计阶段就优化用户体验。

title: Variance Computation for Weighted Model Counting with Knowledge Compilation Approach
comments: 25 pages; accepted for AAAI 2026 main track
summary: One of the most important queries in knowledge compilation is weighted model counting (WMC), which has been applied to probabilistic inference on various models, such as Bayesian networks. In practical situations on inference tasks, the model's parameters have uncertainty because they are often learned from data, and thus we want to compute the degree of uncertainty in the inference outcome. One possible approach is to regard the inference outcome as a random variable by introducing distributions for the parameters and evaluate the variance of the outcome. Unfortunately, the tractability of computing such a variance is hardly known. Motivated by this, we consider the problem of computing the variance of WMC and investigate this problem's tractability. First, we derive a polynomial time algorithm to evaluate the WMC variance when the input is given as a structured d-DNNF. Second, we prove the hardness of this problem for structured DNNFs, d-DNNFs, and FBDDs, which is intriguing because the latter two allow polynomial time WMC algorithms. Finally, we show an application that measures the uncertainty in the inference of Bayesian networks. We empirically show that our algorithm can evaluate the variance of the marginal probability on real-world Bayesian networks and analyze the impact of the variances of parameters on the variance of the marginal.
comment: 25 pages; accepted for AAAI 2026 main track

AI.title_translation: 知识编译方法下的加权模型计数方差计算
AI.tldr: 本文研究了加权模型计数（WMC）方差的计算及其可处理性，以量化推断不确定性。我们提出了一个针对结构化d-DNNF的多项式时间算法，但证明了该问题对于更一般的知识编译形式（如d-DNNF和FBDD）是难解的。该方法被应用于贝叶斯网络以测量推断不确定性。
AI.motivation: 在实际推断任务中，模型参数通常是从数据中学习得到的，存在不确定性，因此需要计算推断结果的不确定性程度。由于计算加权模型计数（WMC）方差的可处理性尚不清楚，本文旨在研究这一问题。
AI.method: 1. 将推断结果视为随机变量，通过为参数引入分布来评估其方差。2. 针对输入为结构化d-DNNF的情况，推导出一个多项式时间算法来评估WMC方差。3. 将该方法应用于衡量贝叶斯网络推断中的不确定性。
AI.result: 1. 提出了一个多项式时间算法来计算结构化d-DNNF的WMC方差。2. 证明了对于结构化DNNF、d-DNNF和FBDD，该方差计算问题是难解的（即使后两者允许多项式时间WMC）。3. 经验性地证明了该算法可以评估真实世界贝叶斯网络上边际概率的方差，并分析了参数方差对边际方差的影响。
AI.translation: 加权模型计数（WMC）是知识编译中最重要的一项查询，已应用于贝叶斯网络等各种模型的概率推断。在实际推断任务中，由于模型参数通常是从数据中学习得到的，它们具有不确定性，因此我们希望计算推断结果中的不确定性程度。一种可能的方法是为参数引入分布，将推断结果视为一个随机变量，并评估该结果的方差。不幸的是，计算这种方差的可处理性鲜为人知。受此启发，我们考虑计算WMC方差的问题，并研究其可处理性。首先，我们推导出一个多项式时间算法来评估输入为结构化d-DNNF时的WMC方差。其次，我们证明了对于结构化DNNF、d-DNNF和FBDD，该问题是难解的，这一点很有趣，因为后两者允许多项式时间WMC算法。最后，我们展示了一个应用，用于测量贝叶斯网络推断中的不确定性。我们通过实验证明，我们的算法可以评估真实世界贝叶斯网络上边际概率的方差，并分析参数方差对边际方差的影响。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在知识编译方法下计算加权模型计数（WMC）方差的可处理性问题，旨在量化概率推断结果的不确定性。作者提出了一种通过引入参数分布将推断结果视为随机变量的方法来计算方差。主要贡献包括：推导出一个针对结构化d-DNNF的多项式时间WMC方差计算算法；证明了对于结构化DNNF、d-DNNF和FBDD，该方差计算问题是难解的。此外，论文将该算法应用于贝叶斯网络，经验性地展示了其在评估边际概率不确定性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 加权模型计数, 方差计算, 知识编译, 可处理性, 贝叶斯网络
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将计算WMC方差这一重要但可处理性未知的问题引入知识编译领域。其重要性在于，它为量化基于WMC的概率推断（如贝叶斯网络）中的不确定性提供了一个严格的理论框架和实用的算法。研究结果揭示了计算方差与计算WMC本身在复杂性上的显著差异：尽管某些知识编译形式（如d-DNNF）允许高效的WMC计算，但计算其方差却被证明是难解的，这对于依赖这些编译形式的实际应用具有重要的理论指导意义。

title: VeRPO: Verifiable Dense Reward Policy Optimization for Code Generation
summary: Effective reward design is a central challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for code generation. Mainstream pass/fail outcome rewards enforce functional correctness via executing unit tests, but the resulting sparsity limits potential performance gains. While recent work has explored external Reward Models (RM) to generate richer, continuous rewards, the learned RMs suffer from reward misalignment and prohibitive computational cost. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{VeRPO} (\textbf{V}erifiable D\textbf{e}nse \textbf{R}eward \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization), a novel RL framework for code generation that synthesizes \textit{robust and dense rewards fully grounded in verifiable execution feedback}. The core idea of VeRPO is constructing dense rewards from weighted partial success: by dynamically estimating the difficulty weight of each unit test based on the execution statistics during training, a dense reward is derived from the sum of weights of the passed unit tests. To solidify the consistency between partial success and end-to-end functional correctness, VeRPO further integrates the dense signal with global execution outcomes, establishing a robust and dense reward paradigm relying solely on verifiable execution feedback. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and settings demonstrate that VeRPO consistently outperforms outcome-driven and RM-based baselines, achieving up to +8.83\% gain in pass@1 with negligible time cost (< 0.02\%) and zero GPU memory overhead.

AI.title_translation: VeRPO：用于代码生成的**可验证**密集奖励策略优化
AI.tldr: VeRPO是一种新的代码生成强化学习框架，它通过动态加权部分通过的单元测试来构建密集且可验证的奖励，解决了传统稀疏奖励和奖励模型（RM）的缺点。它在性能上优于现有基线，且计算成本极低。
AI.motivation: 传统的代码生成强化学习（RL）依赖于通过单元测试的稀疏的“通过/失败”结果奖励，这限制了性能提升。同时，现有的外部奖励模型（RM）虽然提供了更丰富的奖励，但存在奖励错位和计算成本过高的问题。
AI.method: 提出VeRPO框架，该框架仅依赖可验证的执行反馈来合成鲁棒且密集的奖励。核心方法是通过加权部分成功构建密集奖励：根据训练期间的执行统计数据动态估计每个单元测试的难度权重，然后将通过的单元测试的权重总和作为密集奖励。此外，VeRPO将该密集信号与全局执行结果相结合，以确保部分成功与端到端功能正确性的一致性。
AI.result: 在各种基准和设置上的实验表明，VeRPO始终优于结果驱动型和基于奖励模型（RM）的基线，在pass@1指标上实现了高达+8.83%的提升，同时时间成本可忽略不计（< 0.02%），且零GPU内存开销。
AI.conclusion: VeRPO通过仅依赖可验证的执行反馈，成功构建了一种鲁棒且密集的奖励范式，有效解决了代码生成RL中的奖励稀疏性问题，并在性能和效率上表现出色。
AI.translation: 在代码生成的强化学习（RL）中，有效的奖励设计是核心挑战。主流的通过/失败结果奖励通过执行单元测试来确保功能正确性，但由此产生的稀疏性限制了潜在的性能提升。虽然最近的工作探索了外部奖励模型（RM）来生成更丰富、连续的奖励，但学习到的RM存在奖励错位和计算成本过高的问题。在本文中，我们介绍了VeRPO（可验证密集奖励策略优化），这是一种新颖的用于代码生成的RL框架，它合成了完全基于可验证执行反馈的鲁棒且密集的奖励。VeRPO的核心思想是从加权的部分成功中构建密集奖励：通过根据训练期间的执行统计数据动态估计每个单元测试的难度权重，将通过的单元测试的权重总和作为密集奖励。为了巩固部分成功与端到端功能正确性之间的一致性，VeRPO进一步将密集信号与全局执行结果相结合，建立了一个仅依赖可验证执行反馈的鲁棒且密集的奖励范式。跨越不同基准和设置的广泛实验表明，VeRPO始终优于结果驱动型和基于RM的基线，在pass@1上实现了高达+8.83%的增益，同时时间成本可忽略不计（< 0.02%），且零GPU内存开销。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VeRPO，一个用于代码生成的强化学习框架，旨在解决传统稀疏奖励和奖励模型（RM）的效率和对齐问题。VeRPO通过动态加权单元测试的难度，并基于通过的单元测试权重总和来生成密集、鲁棒且仅依赖可验证执行反馈的奖励。实验证明，VeRPO在pass@1指标上显著优于现有基线（高达+8.83%），且几乎没有引入额外的计算或内存开销。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 代码生成, 密集奖励, 单元测试, 策略优化
AI.comments: VeRPO的创新点在于它巧妙地利用了单元测试的粒度信息来克服奖励稀疏性问题，而无需依赖外部、难以训练和对齐的奖励模型。通过动态加权单元测试难度，该方法能够有效地引导策略学习，使其专注于更具挑战性的部分。更重要的是，它在实现显著性能提升的同时，保持了极低的计算开销（< 0.02%时间成本和零内存开销），这对于实际应用和大规模训练至关重要，解决了现有密集奖励方法的主要限制。

title: Physics-Constrained Cross-Resolution Enhancement Network for Optics-Guided Thermal UAV Image Super-Resolution
summary: Optics-guided thermal UAV image super-resolution has attracted significant research interest due to its potential in all-weather monitoring applications. However, existing methods typically compress optical features to match thermal feature dimensions for cross-modal alignment and fusion, which not only causes the loss of high-frequency information that is beneficial for thermal super-resolution, but also introduces physically inconsistent artifacts such as texture distortions and edge blurring by overlooking differences in the imaging physics between modalities. To address these challenges, we propose PCNet to achieve cross-resolution mutual enhancement between optical and thermal modalities, while physically constraining the optical guidance process via thermal conduction to enable robust thermal UAV image super-resolution. In particular, we design a Cross-Resolution Mutual Enhancement Module (CRME) to jointly optimize thermal image super-resolution and optical-to-thermal modality conversion, facilitating effective bidirectional feature interaction across resolutions while preserving high-frequency optical priors. Moreover, we propose a Physics-Driven Thermal Conduction Module (PDTM) that incorporates two-dimensional heat conduction into optical guidance, modeling spatially-varying heat conduction properties to prevent inconsistent artifacts. In addition, we introduce a temperature consistency loss that enforces regional distribution consistency and boundary gradient smoothness to ensure generated thermal images align with real-world thermal radiation principles. Extensive experiments on VGTSR2.0 and DroneVehicle datasets demonstrate that PCNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both reconstruction quality and downstream tasks including semantic segmentation and object detection.

AI.title_translation: 物理约束跨分辨率增强网络用于光学引导热红外无人机图像超分辨率
AI.tldr: 针对现有光学引导热红外超分方法存在的特征压缩导致信息丢失和物理不一致伪影问题，本文提出PCNet。PCNet利用跨分辨率互增强模块（CRME）进行双向特征交互，并引入物理驱动热传导模块（PDTM）和温度一致性损失，通过模拟热传导过程来物理约束光学引导，显著提升了热红外无人机图像的超分质量和下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的光学引导热红外无人机图像超分辨率方法通常压缩光学特征以匹配热红外特征维度，导致高频信息丢失。此外，它们忽略了模态间成像物理学的差异，引入了纹理失真和边缘模糊等物理不一致的伪影。
AI.method: 提出PCNet网络。核心组件包括：1. **跨分辨率互增强模块 (CRME)**：联合优化热红外超分和光-热模态转换，实现跨分辨率双向特征交互，并保留高频光学先验。2. **物理驱动热传导模块 (PDTM)**：将二维热传导引入光学引导过程，建模空间变化的热传导特性，以防止不一致的伪影。3. **温度一致性损失**：强制执行区域分布一致性和边界梯度平滑性，以确保生成的图像符合真实世界的热辐射原理。
AI.result: 在VGTSR2.0和DroneVehicle数据集上的大量实验表明，PCNet在重建质量和下游任务（包括语义分割和目标检测）方面均显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 光学引导的热红外无人机图像超分辨率因其在全天候监测应用中的潜力而引起了重要的研究兴趣。然而，现有方法通常压缩光学特征以匹配热红外特征维度进行跨模态对齐和融合，这不仅会导致有利于热红外超分辨率的高频信息丢失，还会因忽略模态间成像物理学的差异而引入纹理失真和边缘模糊等物理不一致的伪影。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了PCNet，以实现光学和热红外模态之间的跨分辨率相互增强，同时通过热传导物理约束光学引导过程，从而实现鲁棒的热红外无人机图像超分辨率。具体而言，我们设计了一个跨分辨率互增强模块（CRME）来联合优化热红外图像超分辨率和光到热模态转换，促进跨分辨率的有效双向特征交互，同时保留高频光学先验。此外，我们提出了一个物理驱动热传导模块（PDTM），将二维热传导纳入光学引导中，建模空间变化的热传导特性以防止不一致的伪影。此外，我们引入了温度一致性损失，强制执行区域分布一致性和边界梯度平滑性，以确保生成的超分辨率热红外图像与真实世界的热辐射原理保持一致。在VGTSR2.0和DroneVehicle数据集上进行的大量实验表明，PCNet在重建质量以及包括语义分割和目标检测在内的下游任务上均显著优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种物理约束跨分辨率增强网络（PCNet），用于解决光学引导热红外无人机图像超分辨率中现有方法存在的高频信息丢失和物理不一致伪影问题。PCNet通过设计跨分辨率互增强模块（CRME）实现双向特征交互，并通过物理驱动热传导模块（PDTM）结合热传导原理对光学引导进行物理约束。该方法还引入了温度一致性损失。实验证明，PCNet在重建质量和下游任务（如分割和检测）上均优于SOTA方法。
AI.keywords: 热红外图像超分辨率, 光学引导, 物理约束, 跨分辨率增强, 热传导
AI.comments: 本文的核心创新在于将物理学原理（热传导）明确地整合到跨模态超分辨率任务中，以解决现有方法中常见的物理不一致性伪影问题。这种“物理约束”的方法论对于提升多模态融合任务的鲁棒性和可解释性具有重要意义。通过同时优化跨分辨率特征交互和物理建模，PCNet有效地平衡了信息增强和物理真实性，尤其适用于对精度要求高的全天候无人机监测应用。

title: CloudMatch: Weak-to-Strong Consistency Learning for Semi-Supervised Cloud Detection
summary: Due to the high cost of annotating accurate pixel-level labels, semi-supervised learning has emerged as a promising approach for cloud detection. In this paper, we propose CloudMatch, a semi-supervised framework that effectively leverages unlabeled remote sensing imagery through view-consistency learning combined with scene-mixing augmentations. An observation behind CloudMatch is that cloud patterns exhibit structural diversity and contextual variability across different scenes and within the same scene category. Our key insight is that enforcing prediction consistency across diversely augmented views, incorporating both inter-scene and intra-scene mixing, enables the model to capture the structural diversity and contextual richness of cloud patterns. Specifically, CloudMatch generates one weakly augmented view along with two complementary strongly augmented views for each unlabeled image: one integrates inter-scene patches to simulate contextual variety, while the other employs intra-scene mixing to preserve semantic coherence. This approach guides pseudolabel generation and enhances generalization. Extensive experiments show that CloudMatch achieves good performance, demonstrating its capability to utilize unlabeled data efficiently and advance semi-supervised cloud detection.

AI.title_translation: CloudMatch：用于半监督云检测的弱到强一致性学习
AI.tldr: CloudMatch是一种半监督云检测框架，它通过结合场景混合增强（跨场景和场景内）的视图一致性学习，高效利用未标记遥感数据。
AI.motivation: 由于精确的像素级标签标注成本高昂，因此半监督学习成为云检测的有前景方法。该研究的观察是云模式在不同场景和同一场景类别中表现出结构多样性和上下文变异性。
AI.method: 提出CloudMatch框架，采用视图一致性学习结合场景混合增强。具体而言，为每张未标记图像生成一个弱增强视图和两个互补的强增强视图：一个强视图整合跨场景补丁（模拟上下文变化），另一个强视图采用场景内混合（保留语义连贯性）。通过强制预测一致性来指导伪标签生成和增强泛化能力。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，CloudMatch取得了良好的性能，证明了其有效利用未标记数据和推进半监督云检测的能力。
AI.conclusion: CloudMatch是一个有效的半监督框架，能够高效利用未标记遥感图像，并推进了半监督云检测领域的发展。
AI.translation: 由于标注精确像素级标签的成本高昂，半监督学习已成为云检测的一种有前景的方法。在本文中，我们提出了CloudMatch，一个半监督框架，它通过结合场景混合增强的视图一致性学习，有效利用未标记的遥感图像。CloudMatch背后的一个观察是，云模式在不同场景和同一场景类别中表现出结构多样性和上下文变异性。我们的关键见解是，在纳入场景间和场景内混合的多种增强视图之间强制执行预测一致性，使模型能够捕获云模式的结构多样性和上下文丰富性。具体而言，CloudMatch为每张未标记图像生成一个弱增强视图以及两个互补的强增强视图：一个整合了场景间补丁以模拟上下文变化，另一个采用场景内混合以保留语义连贯性。这种方法指导了伪标签的生成并增强了泛化能力。广泛的实验表明，CloudMatch取得了良好的性能，证明了其有效利用未标记数据和推进半监督云检测的能力。
AI.summary: CloudMatch是一个用于半监督云检测的新框架。它解决了云模式结构多样性的挑战，通过实施“弱到强”的一致性学习。该方法为未标记图像创建了三种视图：一个弱增强视图和两个强增强视图（分别使用场景间和场景内混合），以确保预测在多样化上下文中的一致性，从而高效利用未标记数据并提高泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 云检测, 半监督学习, 一致性学习, 遥感, 场景混合
AI.comments: 创新点在于为云检测量身定制的视图一致性学习。它通过结合场景间和场景内混合增强，明确解决了云模式的结构多样性和上下文变异性问题。这种方法有效地将半监督学习范式应用于遥感图像分割任务，提高了模型利用未标记数据的效率和泛化能力。

title: PALM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Personalized Audio-Language Models
summary: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have demonstrated strong performance in audio understanding and generation. Yet, our extensive benchmarking reveals that their behavior is largely generic (e.g., summarizing spoken content) and fails to adequately support personalized question answering (e.g., summarizing what my best friend says). In contrast, human conditions their interpretation and decision-making on each individual's personal context. To bridge this gap, we formalize the task of Personalized LALMs (PALM) for recognizing personal concepts and reasoning within personal context. Moreover, we create the first benchmark (PALM-Bench) to foster the methodological advances in PALM and enable structured evaluation on several tasks across multi-speaker scenarios. Our extensive experiments on representative open-source LALMs, show that existing training-free prompting and supervised fine-tuning strategies, while yield improvements, remains limited in modeling personalized knowledge and transferring them across tasks robustly. Data and code will be released.

AI.title_translation: PALM-Bench：一个用于个性化音频-语言模型的综合基准测试
AI.tldr: 现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）缺乏个性化能力。本文提出了个性化LALMs（PALM）任务，并创建了首个基准测试PALM-Bench，用于评估模型在多说话人场景下识别和推理个人概念的能力。实验显示现有方法在处理个性化知识方面表现有限。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）虽然性能强大，但行为过于通用，无法支持个性化问答（例如，总结特定人物的发言）。为了弥合LALMs与人类在利用个人上下文进行解释和决策方面的差距，作者提出了个性化LALMs（PALM）的任务。
AI.method: 1. 正式定义了个性化LALMs (PALM) 任务，旨在识别个人概念并在个人上下文中进行推理。2. 创建了首个基准测试PALM-Bench，用于在多说话人场景下的多项任务上进行结构化评估。3. 对代表性的开源LALMs使用了免训练提示和监督微调策略进行评估。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，现有的免训练提示和监督微调策略虽然能带来改进，但在建模个性化知识和稳健地跨任务迁移这些知识方面仍然存在局限性。
AI.conclusion: 现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在建模和跨任务迁移个性化知识方面存在显著局限性，凸显了PALM-Bench在推动未来个性化音频-语言模型研究中的重要性。
AI.translation: 大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）在音频理解和生成方面表现出强大的性能。然而，我们广泛的基准测试揭示了它们的行为大多是通用的（例如，总结口语内容），并且未能充分支持个性化问答（例如，总结我最好的朋友说了什么）。相比之下，人类的解释和决策是基于每个个体的个人上下文的。为了弥合这一差距，我们正式定义了个性化LALMs（PALM）的任务，用于识别个人概念并在个人上下文中进行推理。此外，我们创建了第一个基准测试（PALM-Bench），以促进PALM的方法学进步，并能够在多说话人场景下的多项任务上进行结构化评估。我们对具有代表性的开源LALMs进行的广泛实验表明，现有的免训练提示和监督微调策略虽然能带来改进，但在建模个性化知识和稳健地跨任务迁移这些知识方面仍然存在局限性。数据和代码将发布。
AI.summary: 本文指出现有的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）缺乏处理个人上下文和支持个性化问答的能力。为解决此问题，作者正式提出了个性化LALMs（PALM）的任务，并构建了首个综合基准测试PALM-Bench，用于多说话人场景下的结构化评估。通过对现有开源LALMs进行实验，发现当前的提示和微调策略在建模和稳健迁移个性化知识方面存在明显限制，强调了未来研究的必要性。
AI.keywords: 个性化音频-语言模型, 基准测试, LALMs, 个人上下文, 多说话人
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于正式定义并提出了“个性化音频-语言模型”（PALM）这一重要的新研究方向，直接针对现有LALMs在多说话人/多用户场景中缺乏个体识别和上下文推理能力的局限性。PALM-Bench的创建为该领域提供了一个急需的、结构化的评估工具，对于推动模型从通用理解迈向个性化智能具有重要意义。局限性在于抽象并未详细说明PALM-Bench的具体数据构成或任务类型，但其明确指出现有SOTA方法表现不佳，为后续研究设定了清晰的挑战目标。

title: Persona-aware and Explainable Bikeability Assessment: A Vision-Language Model Approach
summary: Bikeability assessment is essential for advancing sustainable urban transportation and creating cyclist-friendly cities, and it requires incorporating users' perceptions of safety and comfort. Yet existing perception-based bikeability assessment approaches face key limitations in capturing the complexity of road environments and adequately accounting for heterogeneity in subjective user perceptions. This paper proposes a persona-aware Vision-Language Model framework for bikeability assessment with three novel contributions: (i) theory-grounded persona conditioning based on established cyclist typology that generates persona-specific explanations via chain-of-thought reasoning; (ii) multi-granularity supervised fine-tuning that combines scarce expert-annotated reasoning with abundant user ratings for joint prediction and explainable assessment; and (iii) AI-enabled data augmentation that creates controlled paired data to isolate infrastructure variable impacts. To test and validate this framework, we developed a panoramic image-based crowdsourcing system and collected 12,400 persona-conditioned assessments from 427 cyclists. Experiment results show that the proposed framework offers competitive bikeability rating prediction while uniquely enabling explainable factor attribution.

AI.title_translation: 基于个性化感知和可解释性的骑行适宜性评估：一种视觉-语言模型方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的框架，用于评估城市骑行适宜性。该模型考虑不同骑行者类型（个性化感知），并结合专家知识和用户评分，提供可解释的评分预测和因素归因，性能具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 骑行适宜性评估对于推动可持续城市交通和创建骑行友好型城市至关重要。然而，现有的基于感知的评估方法在捕捉道路环境复杂性和充分考虑用户主观感知异质性方面存在关键局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于个性化感知的视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，包含三个创新点：(i) 基于既定骑行者类型学的理论基础个性化条件设置，通过思维链推理生成个性化解释；(ii) 结合稀缺专家标注推理和丰富用户评分的多粒度监督微调，用于联合预测和可解释性评估；(iii) AI驱动的数据增强，创建受控配对数据以隔离基础设施变量影响。通过一个基于全景图像的众包系统收集了12,400份评估数据进行验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的框架提供了具有竞争力的骑行适宜性评分预测，同时独特地实现了可解释的因素归因。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于视觉-语言模型的框架成功地实现了具有竞争力的骑行适宜性预测，并提供了独特的、个性化感知的可解释性因素归因，克服了现有方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 骑行适宜性评估对于推动可持续城市交通和创建骑行友好型城市至关重要，它需要纳入用户对安全性和舒适性的感知。然而，现有的基于感知的骑行适宜性评估方法在捕捉道路环境的复杂性和充分考虑用户主观感知异质性方面面临着关键局限。本文提出了一种基于个性化感知的视觉-语言模型框架，用于骑行适宜性评估，并做出了三项新颖贡献：(i) 基于既定骑行者类型学的理论基础个性化条件设置，通过思维链推理生成针对特定个体的解释；(ii) 结合稀缺专家标注推理和丰富用户评分的多粒度监督微调，用于联合预测和可解释性评估；(iii) AI驱动的数据增强，创建受控配对数据以隔离基础设施变量的影响。为了测试和验证该框架，我们开发了一个基于全景图像的众包系统，并从427名骑行者那里收集了12,400份基于个性化感知的评估。实验结果表明，所提出的框架提供了具有竞争力的骑行适宜性评分预测，同时独特地实现了可解释的因素归因。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个基于个性化感知的视觉-语言模型（VLM）框架，以解决现有骑行适宜性评估方法在处理环境复杂性和主观感知异质性方面的局限。该框架的核心创新包括基于理论的个性化条件设置和思维链推理、结合专家和用户数据的多粒度监督微调，以及用于隔离基础设施影响的AI数据增强。通过对12,400份众包评估数据的验证，该框架在提供有竞争力的评分预测的同时，独特地实现了基于个体骑行者个性的可解释因素归因。
AI.keywords: Bikeability Assessment, Vision-Language Model, Persona-aware, Explainability, Chain-of-Thought
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将“个性化感知”（基于骑行者类型学）和“可解释性”（通过思维链推理实现）明确地整合到骑行适宜性评估中，解决了现有感知评估模型在处理用户主观异质性方面的核心问题。采用视觉-语言模型（VLM）来融合道路图像信息和主观感知，为城市规划提供了基于用户视角的、可操作的洞察。此外，结合专家标注和大众评分的多粒度微调方法，有效利用了不同质量的数据资源。这对推动更精细化和以人为本的城市交通规划具有重要意义。

title: Spider web-inspired sensing and computation with fiber network physical reservoirs
summary: Physical reservoir computing leverages the intrinsic dynamics of mechanical systems to perform computation through their natural responses to input signals. Here, we study a compliant fiber network inspired by orb-weaving spider webs and investigate how its mechanical design and operating conditions shape its computational capability. Using Cosserat rod-based simulations, we identify how network topology, geometry, actuation, and axial tension impact the nonlinear computation and memory capacity of the network. We further evaluate several readout reduction strategies to assess how computational performance varies with the number and placement of measured outputs. We then experimentally validate these results using a physical fiber-network prototype. Overall, results provide insights and guidance on design, actuation, and sensing choices to enable fiber networks for mechano-intelligent computation. They demonstrate the ability of structured compliant fibers networks to serve as physical reservoirs capable of nonlinear transformation and input-history retention.

AI.title_translation: 蜘蛛网启发的纤维网络物理储层的传感与计算
AI.tldr: 研究了一种受蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络作为物理储层，利用Cosserat杆模拟和实验验证，确定了网络设计参数（拓扑结构、几何形状、张力等）如何影响其非线性计算和记忆能力，为机械智能计算提供了设计指导。
AI.motivation: 研究受圆网蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络，并探究其机械设计和操作条件如何影响其计算能力，以实现机械智能计算。
AI.method: 1. 使用基于Cosserat杆的模拟来确定网络拓扑、几何形状、驱动和轴向张力对非线性计算和记忆容量的影响。2. 评估了几种读出减少策略，以评估计算性能如何随测量输出的数量和位置而变化。3. 使用物理纤维网络原型对结果进行实验验证。
AI.result: 研究结果提供了关于设计、驱动和传感选择的见解和指导，能够使纤维网络实现机械智能计算。
AI.conclusion: 结构化柔性纤维网络能够作为物理储层，具备非线性转换和输入历史保留的能力，为机械智能计算提供了设计和传感选择的指导。
AI.translation: 物理储层计算利用机械系统的内在动力学，通过其对输入信号的自然响应来进行计算。本文研究了一种受圆网蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络，并探讨了其机械设计和操作条件如何塑造其计算能力。利用基于Cosserat杆的模拟，我们确定了网络拓扑、几何形状、驱动和轴向张力如何影响网络的非线性计算和记忆容量。我们进一步评估了几种读出减少策略，以评估计算性能如何随测量输出的数量和位置而变化。随后，我们使用一个物理纤维网络原型对这些结果进行了实验验证。总而言之，研究结果为设计、驱动和传感选择提供了见解和指导，以使纤维网络能够实现机械智能计算。它们证明了结构化柔性纤维网络能够作为物理储层，具备非线性转换和输入历史保留的能力。
AI.summary: 本文研究了受蜘蛛网启发的柔性纤维网络，将其作为物理储层进行计算。研究利用基于Cosserat杆的模拟，系统地考察了网络拓扑结构、几何形状、驱动方式和轴向张力等机械设计参数如何影响网络的非线性计算能力和记忆容量。研究还评估了不同的读出策略，并最终通过物理原型实验验证了模拟结果。研究结论证明了这种结构化柔性纤维网络作为物理储层在机械智能计算中的潜力，并为未来的设计和传感选择提供了指导。
AI.keywords: 物理储层计算, 纤维网络, 蜘蛛网启发, Cosserat杆, 机械智能
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将仿生学（蜘蛛网）与物理储层计算相结合，利用柔性纤维网络的固有机械动力学进行计算，而非依赖传统的电子元件。通过系统地模拟和实验验证，该研究深入分析了材料和结构参数（如拓扑结构、张力）对计算性能的具体影响，为设计高效的“机械智能”设备提供了实用的工程指导。这种方法代表了储层计算硬件实现的一种新颖且有前景的方向。

title: STAR-S: Improving Safety Alignment through Self-Taught Reasoning on Safety Rules
summary: Defending against jailbreak attacks is crucial for the safe deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). Recent research has attempted to improve safety by training models to reason over safety rules before responding. However, a key issue lies in determining what form of safety reasoning effectively defends against jailbreak attacks, which is difficult to explicitly design or directly obtain. To address this, we propose \textbf{STAR-S} (\textbf{S}elf-\textbf{TA}ught \textbf{R}easoning based on \textbf{S}afety rules), a framework that integrates the learning of safety rule reasoning into a self-taught loop. The core of STAR-S involves eliciting reasoning and reflection guided by safety rules, then leveraging fine-tuning to enhance safety reasoning. Repeating this process creates a synergistic cycle. Improvements in the model's reasoning and interpretation of safety rules allow it to produce better reasoning data under safety rule prompts, which is then utilized for further training. Experiments show that STAR-S effectively defends against jailbreak attacks, outperforming baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/pikepokenew/STAR_S.git.

AI.title_translation: STAR-S：通过基于安全规则的自学推理改进安全对齐
AI.tldr: STAR-S框架使用基于安全规则的自学推理循环来训练LLM进行安全推理和反思，以解决难以设计有效推理形式的问题，从而有效提高模型防御越狱攻击的能力。
AI.motivation: 防御越狱攻击对于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全部署至关重要。现有研究难以明确设计或直接获取能够有效防御越狱攻击的安全推理形式。
AI.method: 本文提出了STAR-S框架，将安全规则推理的学习整合到自学循环中。具体方法是：首先，在安全规则的指导下激发推理和反思；其次，利用微调增强安全推理；最后，重复该过程，利用模型改进后的推理能力生成更好的推理数据进行进一步训练，形成协同循环。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，STAR-S能有效防御越狱攻击，并优于基线模型。
AI.translation: 防御越狱攻击对于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全部署至关重要。最近的研究试图通过训练模型在响应前对安全规则进行推理来提高安全性。然而，一个关键问题在于确定何种形式的安全推理能够有效防御越狱攻击，而这种形式难以明确设计或直接获取。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了**STAR-S**（基于安全规则的**自学推理**）框架，该框架将安全规则推理的学习集成到一个自学循环中。STAR-S的核心在于，在安全规则的指导下激发推理和反思，然后利用微调来增强安全推理。重复这一过程创造了一个协同循环。模型在安全规则的推理和解释方面的改进使其能够在安全规则提示下产生更好的推理数据，这些数据随后被用于进一步的训练。实验表明，STAR-S能有效防御越狱攻击，性能优于基线模型。代码可在：https://github.com/pikepokenew/STAR_S.git 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了STAR-S（基于安全规则的自学推理）框架，旨在通过自学循环增强LLM的安全对齐能力，以防御越狱攻击。该框架通过迭代地激发模型在安全规则指导下的推理和反思，并利用微调来强化这种推理能力。随着模型对安全规则的理解和解释能力的提高，它能生成更高质量的训练数据用于进一步训练，形成持续改进的协同过程。实验证明STAR-S在防御越狱攻击方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 安全对齐, 自学推理, 越狱攻击, 安全规则, LLM
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入“自学循环”机制来解决难以显式设计有效安全推理形式的挑战。STAR-S通过迭代地激发、反思和微调，使得模型能够持续自我完善其对安全规则的理解和推理能力。这种协同学习方法提供了一种强大的数据增强策略，有望提高LLM防御不断演变的越狱攻击的鲁棒性。

title: DeepSynth-Eval: Objectively Evaluating Information Consolidation in Deep Survey Writing
summary: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) towards autonomous agents has catalyzed progress in Deep Research. While retrieval capabilities are well-benchmarked, the post-retrieval synthesis stage--where agents must digest massive amounts of context and consolidate fragmented evidence into coherent, long-form reports--remains under-evaluated due to the subjectivity of open-ended writing. To bridge this gap, we introduce DeepSynth-Eval, a benchmark designed to objectively evaluate information consolidation capabilities. We leverage high-quality survey papers as gold standards, reverse-engineering research requests and constructing "Oracle Contexts" from their bibliographies to isolate synthesis from retrieval noise. We propose a fine-grained evaluation protocol using General Checklists (for factual coverage) and Constraint Checklists (for structural organization), transforming subjective judgment into verifiable metrics. Experiments across 96 tasks reveal that synthesizing information from hundreds of references remains a significant challenge. Our results demonstrate that agentic plan-and-write workflows significantly outperform single-turn generation, effectively reducing hallucinations and improving adherence to complex structural constraints.

AI.title_translation: DeepSynth-Eval：客观评估深度综述写作中的信息整合能力
AI.tldr: 我们创建了DeepSynth-Eval基准，用于客观评估LLMs将海量零散信息整合为长篇综述报告的能力，结果显示，基于代理的“规划-写作”方法远优于简单的单次生成。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在检索能力上表现良好，但在深度研究中，代理（agents）需要消化大量上下文并将零散证据整合为连贯的长篇报告的“后检索合成阶段”仍缺乏客观评估，因为开放式写作具有主观性。
AI.method: 引入了DeepSynth-Eval基准，旨在客观评估信息整合能力。该方法使用高质量的综述论文作为黄金标准，逆向工程研究请求，并从其参考文献中构建“Oracle Contexts”以隔离合成与检索的干扰。提出了一种细粒度的评估协议，使用通用清单（General Checklists，评估事实覆盖）和约束清单（Constraint Checklists，评估结构组织），将主观判断转化为可验证的指标。
AI.result: 对96项任务的实验表明，从数百个参考文献中合成信息仍然是一项重大挑战。结果显示，基于代理的“规划-写作”（plan-and-write）工作流程显著优于单轮生成，有效地减少了幻觉并提高了对复杂结构约束的遵守程度。
AI.conclusion: DeepSynth-Eval成功地提供了一个客观评估深度综述写作中信息整合能力的基准。研究证明，尽管挑战巨大，但采用规划和写作的代理工作流程是提高信息合成质量、减少幻觉和满足复杂结构要求的有效途径。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）向自主代理的演进推动了深度研究的进步。尽管检索能力已经得到了充分的基准测试，但后检索合成阶段——即代理必须消化大量上下文并将零散证据整合为连贯的长篇报告的阶段——由于开放式写作的主观性而仍然缺乏评估。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了DeepSynth-Eval，这是一个旨在客观评估信息整合能力的基准。我们利用高质量的综述论文作为黄金标准，逆向工程研究请求，并从其参考文献中构建“Oracle Contexts”，以将合成能力与检索的干扰隔离开来。我们提出了一种细粒度的评估协议，使用通用清单（用于事实覆盖）和约束清单（用于结构组织），将主观判断转化为可验证的指标。对96项任务的实验表明，从数百个参考文献中合成信息仍然是一项重大挑战。我们的结果证明，基于代理的“规划-写作”工作流程显著优于单轮生成，有效地减少了幻觉并改善了对复杂结构约束的遵守。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了DeepSynth-Eval，这是一个旨在客观评估深度综述写作中信息整合能力的基准。鉴于LLMs在深度研究中将大量上下文合成为连贯长报告的后检索合成阶段缺乏评估，研究人员利用高质量综述论文作为黄金标准，构建“Oracle Contexts”来隔离合成能力。通过采用细粒度的通用清单（事实覆盖）和约束清单（结构组织），该基准将主观判断转化为可验证的指标。实验结果表明，从数百个参考文献中合成信息仍然是一个重大挑战，但基于代理的“规划-写作”工作流程显著优于单轮生成，能有效减少幻觉并更好地遵守复杂的结构约束。
AI.keywords: DeepSynth-Eval, 信息整合, 深度综述写作, LLM评估, 代理工作流程
